checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly four text blocks visibly separated by clear space
must.why: Title and date lines are tightly stacked with almost no space between them; the other blocks are spaced unevenly.
The end time reads '2200' with no colon.

must.item: Fourth block reads 'Free entry • Everyone welcome'; no other wording
must.why: Correct, and there are no extra words.

must.item: Portrait 4:5, dark blue, warm lanterns, legible
must.why: 512x640 is 4:5. The background is dark blue with glowing lanterns. All text is legible.

faults.what: The date line has a missing colon: '2200' instead of '22:00'. This is a wrong time on an event flyer.
The title and date lines are crammed together with no clear gap. This breaks the request for clear space between blocks.
Spacing between blocks is uneven. The text sits in the middle and is small, and the title is not prominent.

summary: The flyer has a good dark blue and lantern look in 4:5, but the time reads '2200' instead of '22:00', and the title and date lines are crowded together with no clear space between them.
